newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to Watch.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to Watch.

text.p: * Coca-Cola Co is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $0.31, compared to $0.26 a year ago, according to First Call. Shares closed at 56-3/8.

* A clause of ITT Corp's articles of incorporation allowing it to expand its board could help could help the company fight the $6.5 billion hostile bid from Hilton Hotels Corp, the Wall Street Journal said. ITT shares closed at 56-7/8. Hilton closed at 28-5/8.

* High techs led the general decline in U.S. shares traded in London. International Business Machines Corp was down 1/2 at 157-3/8. Intel Corp was down 3/4 at 159-3/8. Texas Instruments Inc was down 1/4 at 74-3/8.
* Gilead Sciences Inc reported a fourth quarter loss of $0.28 compared to $0.47 a year ago. The First call estimate was for a loss of $0.35. The stock closed at 3-7/8.
The New York Times Market Place writes that shares in Gilead shares soared earlier this week after the company announced that it would soon begin clinical tests of a drug ready to treat influenza.
But a little known Australian company, Biota Holdings Ltd, has a similar drug well advanced in human trials and could beat Gilead to the market by at least two years, the New York Times said.
